bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 76
tmp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
{
echo "## PR #55 production preflight (Host readback)"
echo "Request: req_20261115051200000000c069"
echo '~~~'
printf 'INLINE_SUPPORT='
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("/run/secrets/bot_token","utf8").trim();const c=new AbortController();setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),12000);fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+t+"/getMe",{signal:c.signal}).then(r=>r.json()).then(x=>{if(!x.ok||!x.result){console.log("BOT_GETME_FAILED")}else{console.log(x.result.supports_inline_queries===true?"ENABLED":"DISABLED");console.log("BOT_ID="+x.result.id)}}).catch(()=>console.log("BOT_GETME_NETWORK_FAIL"))' || echo BOT_API_COMMAND_FAILED
echo DB_LINK_SCHEMA_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' ORDER BY ordinal_position" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
echo DB_LINK_SCHEMA_END
docker inspect --format 'LIVE_IMAGE_ID={{.Image}} LIVE_RUNNING={{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
docker image inspect --format 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE_ID={{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr55-eca6846
echo '~~~'
} > "$tmp"
gh issue comment 55 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file "$tmp" >/dev/null
echo PREDEPLOY_READBACK_POSTED=PASS
